question: Was the 5 mM KNO3 of the high-N treatment added on top of complete Hoagland N (2 mM Ca(NO3)2 + 1.25 mM NH4NO3) or did it replace it?
proposed_answer: Most likely added (replacement would give 5 mM N, below the 6.5 mM N control, contradicting the high-N label): HN = 11.5 mM N, mixed (10.25 mM NO3- + 1.25 mM NH4+). Left N_amount and N_form NR until confirmed; rank 2 kept.
evidence: PMC12430503 Methods 4.6: 'transferred to Hoagland nutrient solution ... 5 mM KNO3 was used for high-nitrogen treatment'; complete Hoagland composition listed separately. Micronutrient units in that list (e.g. 10 mM H3BO3, 0.5 mM (NH4)6Mo7O24) look like uM typos.
